Cassettes recorded from `cveawg-test.mitre.org` live in `src/testdata/recorded/`, shared with the Zig client, and come from `scripts/record-fixtures.mjs`. `cassette()` in `helpers.ts` turns one into an upstream route that answers with the recorded status, headers and body.

The files here are hand-written from the CVE Services OpenAPI spec (`CVEProject/cve-services`, `api-docs/openapi.json` and `schemas/`), because recording them needs a CNA account on the test instance: `reserve.json`, `cve-id-list.json`, `user.json` and `publish.json` are authenticated responses, `bad-request.json` is a rejected write, and `record.json` is a request body. `scripts/record-fixtures.mjs --writes` with `CVE_API_ORG`, `CVE_API_USER` and `CVE_API_KEY` set records cassettes under the same names; then switch the imports to `cassette()`.
